name: Agamand Family Crypt
summary: The Scourge holds the Agamand Family Crypt just north of Agamand Mills. It was the ancient resting ground of one of Tirisfal's wealthiest farming dynasties, but Captain Dargol has opened its tombs and raised the ancestors as mindless terrors.

sections.title: Restless Ancestors
sections.body: The Agamand family once held broad estates across northern Tirisfal Glades, and buried their ancestors in this hillside crypt. The Plague ruined the kingdom, and Captain Dargol, an agent of the Scourge, seized the tombs. Through dark necromancy, he awakened the Agamand dead as vengeful skeletons and apparitions. Their restless forms now make the family burial ground a Scourge foothold beside Forsaken territory.

faq.q: Where is the Agamand Family Crypt located?
faq.answer: You’ll find the crypt carved into a hillside just north of Agamand Mills, in northern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Who controls the crypt right now?
faq.answer: Captain Dargol controls the crypt for the Scourge and commands the raised dead.

faq.q: What will I encounter inside the crypt?
faq.answer: Awakened skeletons and vengeful spirits of the Agamand ancestors fill the crypt. Dark magic drives them to attack anyone who enters the tombs.

faq.q: Are the undead inside the crypt allied with the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No. The dead in the crypt serve the Scourge under Captain Dargol and are hostile to Forsaken and living travelers alike.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face an intolerable Scourge presence in Tirisfal. Captain Dargol's occupation mocks the dead and threatens the Undercity's northern frontier.
